# Install {#admin-install}

Kailash ships bootable images for x86_64 and aarch64, in two formats
per profile: a QEMU disk image (the primary shape) and a bootable ISO.

| Profile | Scope |
|---|---|
| `minimal` | the core substrate, no tool categories enabled |
| `redteam-ai` | the AI red-team lab scope |
| `full` | the everything-live lab scope |
| `headless-agent` | base + CLI only, no desktop |

Download surfaces and the per-target size budgets are documented on
the main site's [images page](https://kailash.site); verify every
download against the release's SHA256SUMS sheet before first boot.
